source.table: Table A-1. Income Summary Measures by Selected Characteristics: 2022 and 2023
source.title: Percent change in real median income (2023 less 2022)

unit_note: Percent-change block of the summary table: every cell is a derived comparison of the two year columns (ratio arithmetic, outside the frozen relation vocabulary) or its MOE; all cells standalone.
